856-4321-5686-8347.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Food.
You control at least one additional creature.
856-4321-5686-8347.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Sela trigger.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood artifact token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, creating a Food and Blood token.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

141-1070-5231.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1070-5231.description:
Cast Rise Again by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Rise Again.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding {R}.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Rise Again
Resolve the Rise Again copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

4247-7435--5.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hardened Academic triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 1.
Repeat.

339-677-4742-6495.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5231-6719.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5231-6719.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

824-2728-3967-5662.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-2728-3967-5662.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-2728-3967-5662.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reyhan and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reyhan trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 4.

1580-2511-4556-4871.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

670-1619-6152-6473.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-6152-6473.description:
Cast Mardu Siegebreaker by paying its mana cost.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Mardu Siegebreaker trigger, exiling Veteran Dungeoneer until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Mardu Siegebreaker.
Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, causing Veteran Dungeoneer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Veteran Dungeoneer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Veteran Dungeoneer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Mardu Siegebreaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Mardu Siegebreaker trigger, exiling Veteran Dungeoneer until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Mardu Siegebreaker.
Repeat from step 5.

3532-5078-6747-6792.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-6747-6792.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Mm'menon.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6556-7736.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shang-Chi and the Ten Rings triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-6596-7375.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Hermes
1618-2440-6596-7375.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Arc Blade.
Arc Blade triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Hermes triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Arc Blade.
Repeat.
1618-2440-6596-7375.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Hermes. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

4053-4460-5499--5.notablePrerequisites: The creature with persist does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
4053-4460-5499--5.description:
Activate the creature with persist by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the persist creature.
Repeat.

4605-4681-6797-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand by paying {5}{G}{G} or from your graveyard for its harmonize cost by paying at most {5}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Karmic Guide and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Karmic Guide token enters, it triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2511-5751-6462-7104-7105.description:
Cast Tower Winder from your graveyard by paying {1}{G} and discarding Command Tower
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When Tower Winder enters, it triggers, returning Command Tower from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Tower Winder.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3334-3488-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Katsumasa
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-1479-1669-3875.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-1669-3875.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Tireless Provisioner and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1978-3053-3918.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three basic land types among lands you control
1978-3053-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Prismatic Geoscope's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct or activate Trazyn using Voltaic Construct's ability by paying {2}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.

2459-4053-5256-6989.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Rograkh.
Cast Rograkh from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

413-772-6553.easyPrerequisites: Shade's Form attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
413-772-6553.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Brotherhood Outcast trigger, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

710-2511-2843.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

144-628-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, it triggers, as well as its undying ability if it does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down.
Resolve the second trigger, doing nothing.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
When Ashcloud Phoenix dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio abilities from steps 1 and 5, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

2103-4477-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Capture of Jingzhou and Greenwarden of Murasa each turn.
2103-4477-6122.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Greenwarden of Murasa by paying its mana cost.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Greenwarden of Murasa from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

4094-4826-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
4094-4826-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites:
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
4094-4826-5702-5954.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Archelos
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko trigger twice.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Archelos
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

1031-3557-4872.notablePrerequisites: Brago does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked an opponent.
1031-3557-4872.description:
Deal combat damage using Brago.
Brago triggers, blinking Invasion of Arcavios.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand, or searching your library for Time Warp and putting it into your hand, if needed.
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1168-1257-1651-2841-3698.notablePrerequisites:
Walking Atlas does not have summoning sickness.
It is not your turn.
1168-1257-1651-2841-3698.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
Ghost Town enters the battlefield, triggering Toggo, creating a Rock equipment artifact token.
The Rock token enters the battlefield, triggering Grinding Station, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Ghost Town's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Rock token and Grinding Station, untapping Walking Atlas.
Repeat.

232-586-2034-4359.manaNeeded: {2}{B}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
232-586-2034-4359.description:
Cast Priest of Gix by paying {2}{B}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Priest of Gix, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying {2}{R}.
When Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Garna either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B}{R} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Garna enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Garna, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Garna trigger, returning it, Priest of Gix and Priest of Urabrask from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

339-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Jegantha.
Jegantha does not have summoning sickness.
339-3525.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Jegantha.
Repeat.
